name: deploy
title_zh: Railway 或 Fly.io 上 10 分钟跑起
tagline_zh: 在 claude.ai 和手机里用你自己的银行连接器，不用碰云厂商控制台。带域名、数据卷、设置页。
tagline_en: Run your own bank connector in claude.ai & on mobile. Domain, volume, setup page included—no cloud console.
desc_en: Deploy BankMCP™ to a small server so it works in claude.ai and on the phone: Railway or Fly.io, volume, domain, setup page, connector. Use when the user says "deploy bankmcp", "host it", "/deploy", "use it on my phone", or "add it to claude.ai".
why_zh: 把部署拆成 Railway 或 Fly.io 两条明确路径，卷和域名自动配好，省掉读三份文档的摸索。
why_en: Two paved paths (Railway/Fly.io) with volume & domain wired automatically—skips the 3-doc scavenger hunt. For self-hosters who.
limit_zh: 只认 BankMCP 这一个项目，不部署其他 MCP。需要你已有 Railway 或 Fly.io 账号并绑卡。
limit_en: Only deploys BankMCP—no other MCPs. Requires existing Railway/Fly.io account with billing. Free tiers won't handle production. Bank API keys not.
title_en: Get BankMCP live on Railway/Fly.io in 10 min
